test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Her collection consists of __rare__ stamps.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Common'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Rare'-** not common or frequent. (दुर्लभ)
 
• ​**Example:** The museum is full of rare and precious treasures.
 
• **'Common'**: normal, usual, average. (सामान्य)
 
• ​**Example**: It is common decency to give your seat to anyone in greater need.
 
• Hence, the correct antonym is** "Common".**

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Disposed'**- Willing or prepared to do something. (झुका हुआ)
 
• **'Essential'**- Completely necessary. (अनिवार्य, आवश्यक)
 
• '**Unique'**- Not like anything else, being the only one of its type. (अद्वितीय, अनोखा)

118:Ta66,

The correct answer is **'Museum'.**<
